tweet.text:
Kimi AI probably contacted so many other creators even much bigger than my account and I'm surprised that I don't see more talking about it, only a couple came out and said it but the rest are just getting paid and pushing fake opinions and not telling anyone about it.

If you are a creator and that's your ethics at least just know that not having a paid partnership label is against the terms of service and i hope you get banned for scamming people.
